content_sections.heading: About BEL Management Industrial Trainees (Finance)
content_sections.text: Bharat Electronics Limited-Ghaziabad operates as a premier Navratna Defence Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. The organisation conducts recruitment to engage Management Industrial Trainees (Finance) at its Ghaziabad unit for an initial training period of one year, extendable up to a maximum of three years based on performance reviews.

content_sections.heading: BEL Management Industrial Trainees (Finance) Important Dates
Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following criteria to attend the walk-in interview: Nationality: Only Indian Nationals are eligible. Educational Qualification: Candidates should have passed ICWA Inter / CA Inter. Candidates who do not possess ICWA Inter pass or CA Inter pass certificates are not eligible. Candidates who have acquired or are pursuing higher qualifications are not eligible. Age Limit: Candidate's upper age limit is a maximum of 25 years as on 29.10.2026. Age Relaxation: Relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC & ST candidates, 3 years for OBC candidates, and 10 years for persons with disabilities.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates appearing for the selection process must bring the application form (Annexure-1) along with 1 set of Xerox copies of the following documents and their original certificates for verification: SSLC / 10th Marksheet (for Age Proof) 12th Marksheet / Certificate Degree certificate Original ICWA Inter passed / CA Inter passed certificate issued by competent authority Aadhaar card SC / ST / OBC / PWD / EWS certificate (if applicable) No Objection Certificate (if Govt. / PSU employee) Affixed recent passport-size colour photograph with signature on the application form

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must report at the venue between 09:00 AM and 09:30 AM on 18 November 2026. Entry will be closed at sharp 09:30 AM. Verification of original certificates will be conducted. Selection will be based on the candidate's performance in the interview. Selected candidates will be informed through E-mail followed by the publication of the list of selected candidates on the BEL website.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Initial tenure of training shall be one year, with potential extension of two more years after performance review, up to a maximum of three years. Canteen facility will be provided on a chargeable basis. Transport facility will not be provided. Hostel accommodation will not be provided. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates appearing for the selection process. Suppression of facts and furnishing false information will lead to disqualification or rejection of candidature. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. When is the BEL Management Industrial Trainees (Finance) walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 18 November 2026 from 09:00 AM, with entry closing at sharp 09:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the Human Resource Development Department, Bharat Electronics Limited, Site-IV, Sahibabad Industrial Area, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh – 201010 (In front of Vaishali Metro Station).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for BEL Management Industrial Trainees (Finance)?
faq.answer: There are 11 (Eleven) vacancies available for the Management Industrial Trainees (Finance) post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates should have passed ICWA Inter / CA Inter. Candidates who do not possess these certificates or have acquired/are pursuing higher qualifications are not eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is a maximum of 25 years as on 29.10.2026, with age relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly stipend payable to the trainees?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs. 25,000/- for the 1st year, Rs. 27,000/- for the 2nd year, and Rs. 30,000/- for the 3rd year.

faq.question: Q7. What documents must be brought to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring 1 set of Xerox copies of their 10th marksheet, 12th marksheet, degree certificate, ICWA/CA inter passed certificate, Aadhaar card, category certificate if applicable, NOC if government/PSU employee, and original certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is any TA/DA provided for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates appearing for the selection process.
